faqs.q: 8-3-10-7. PUDs approved prior to effective date.
faqs.a: All PUDs that were approved prior to the effective date of this LDC, including those designated PUD-R, PUD-BP, PUD-BPR, and PUD-I, which were not rezoned to a different zoning district on the effective date of this LDC (collectively, "prior approvals"), and which have not lapsed, shall be rezoned to PUD and be in conformance with the prior approvals.
